final_message:
Generated the DNS configuration for all **49 authoritative zones and 48 delegations**. The assigned servers are pc1–pc49; pc50 is the recursive resolver, using pc1 as its root server. All 60 PC startup files now point to pc50, and the four requested MX records use the existing addresses of their assigned machines.

The topology, IP addresses and existing routes were preserved. The startup scripts pass shell syntax checks. BIND’s configuration-checking tools are not available in this environment, and the laboratory has not been started, so DNS resolution remains unverified at runtime.
